summary: Iter-29 frontend verification: SMM live-charge instant-update bug fix + MyWallet multi-color redesign + regression checks. All 5 review items PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL with test1@example.com / hack123 (Operative tier, wallet ₹4,050.48).
critical_code_review_comments: OrderSmmPage.jsx now uses instantQuote (client-side useMemo) for the visible LIVE CHARGE — the perceptible-delay bug is gone. Verified by typing rapidly: every keystroke updates the [data-testid=smm-charge-display] synchronously (no debounce, no stale ₹0 mid-typing). Math correct: 5000×12.5/1000×0.95(Operative −5%) = ₹59.37 displayed; 1000×... = ₹11.87; sub-min values (5/50/500 units) correctly clamp to min ₹10. Server quote still fires in the background via the 150ms-debounced AbortController call only to refresh walletBalance — exactly as described in the agent-to-agent context.

MyWallet.jsx redesign is solid: balance hero (neon green border, ₹ big), yellow Daily Spin tile linking /me/spin, 3 multi-color method tiles (Cashfree #00ff9d, Manual #ff2d92, Crypto #4de0ff) all render and respond to clicks. Tiles transition into colour-matched forms; 'CHANGE METHOD' back button restores the picker; submitting a manual deposit shows wallet-done-state and toast notification. CashfreeTopupModal opens correctly from wallet-cashfree-cta. Code structure is clean (563 lines, single responsibility, METHOD_META map keeps colours/icons co-located).

MINOR/POLISH (non-blocking): (a) Catalog still shows 'Catalog unavailable: SMM panel error: Invalid API key' banner in preview — known dev-mode issue (3 TEST services seeded as fallback). (b) On /me/wallet the 'NEW DEPOSIT' button (after done state) only resets `method` to null but leaves the success toast visible; fine since toast auto-dismisses. (c) wallet-amount input accepts negative steps via browser spinner because min=10 but step not set — Pydantic backend rejects <10 so no security impact. (d) The Cashfree modal's PCI-DSS subtitle says 'live mode' even when cfConfig.mode === 'sandbox' could match — actual config returned live, so display is correct.
RESIDUAL from iter-28 still applicable: wallet debit + order insert is sequential (not transactional). Not retested this iteration — out of scope.

rca of the issue: Both reported issues are resolved. (1) SMM live-charge delay: ROOT CAUSE was renderedQuote falling back to the server `quote` state which updated only after the 150ms debounced /api/public/smm/quote round-trip. FIX (verified): renderedQuote = instantQuote unconditionally, so the client-side useMemo recomputes synchronously on every quantity change. Server quote still runs in background (now abortable) for wallet refresh, but never overrides the visible number. (2) MyWallet single-green design: REPLACED with 3-tile multi-color method picker (Cashfree green / Manual pink / Crypto cyan) + yellow Daily Spin accent. Each method transitions into a colour-matched form using a shared activeColor variable. All transitions, back-button, and done-state flows verified end-to-end.
